subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw add an explicit capability-gated soft-steer lifecycle, or keep steering limited to safe model/tool boundaries with abort-and-follow-up as the interruption path?
rationale: Source inspection can establish the current limitation, but only maintainers can choose whether transparent same-run continuation is a supported cross-backend product contract and whether it should alter `steer` or become a separate mode.

options.title: Add explicit soft-steer
options.body: Define a new capability-gated mode with documented abort, partial-output, tool-side-effect, resume, and fallback semantics while preserving current `steer` behavior.

options.title: Keep boundary steering
options.body: Fix https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/48003 so current steering reliably reaches safe boundaries, but do not promise transparent mid-generation continuation.

options.title: Use abort and follow-up
options.body: Treat cancellation followed by a normal queued turn as the supported interruption workflow and close the broader feature direction.

recommendation.title: Add explicit soft-steer
recommendation.body: Define a new capability-gated mode with documented abort, partial-output, tool-side-effect, resume, and fallback semantics while preserving current `steer` behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent lifecycle-aware implementation and ownership history spans all three central runtime surfaces.
